comments.body: 修改重新构建镜像后可以渲染mermaid流程图，但是如果点击编辑wiki页面，再保存（或取消），又不能渲染了，需要刷新之后才可以正常渲染

Thanks for the report. Cause: the wiki reader body is rendered under `v-if="!editingPage"`, so saving or cancelling an edit mounts a fresh element whose protected images and mermaid diagrams are pending again, and nothing re-ran those passes (on cancel the rendered content does not change, so the existing watcher never fires). Pushed a follow-up commit that extracts the existing refresh logic into a `refreshReaderBody()` helper and also runs it when editing ends.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
